profile.headline: Software Engineer at Boeing
profile.summary:
5+ years of experience in a software industry. 

Hands-on experience developing enterprise level applications using Software Development Life Cycle. 

Enhanced applications to minimize code and maximize performance. 

Built and deployed enterprise level applications  to continuously support users requests.

Flexible to work with multiple coding languages. 

Next goal: “Senior Software Engineer”
